profile.name: M. Khoirul Huda
profile.tagline: Full Stack Developer with 6+ years of experience, currently working in an international team at Taiwan Mobile. Builds end-to-end web applications from UI to backend and database integration, using JavaScript/TypeScript, React/Next.js, Vue.js, Node.js, and Python (FastAPI).

paragraphs: I am a Full Stack Developer passionate about building interactive and scalable user interfaces (UI), with a strong focus on performance optimization and development efficiency. I enjoy creating digital experiences that are not only visually appealing but also robust and user-friendly.

Currently, I work at Taiwan Mobile, where I develop an AI-powered interview and training platform. Previously, I have developed software across a variety of environments — from start-ups to large enterprises, including a project assignment at BPJS Ketenagakerjaan — covering payment gateway integrations, Google APIs, and various other APIs to deliver complete and functional solutions.
In my spare time, I enjoy exploring new technologies, such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and other modern technologies, to continuously improve my skills and understanding in software development.
about.skillsIntro: Here are a few technologies I’ve been working with recently:

experience.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs: Developed and maintained the user-facing and admin dashboards of an AI-powered interview and training platform using Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
Built a resilient video upload pipeline with streaming upload, real-time progress tracking, automatic retry, and unified error and network-status handling.
Implemented role-based access control and route protection across the admin dashboard with strict TypeScript typing.
Collaborated with a cross-functional engineering team, integrating a FastAPI backend (JWT auth, PostgreSQL, Redis) to deliver end-to-end interview workflows.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer
experience.company: Indocyber Global Teknologi – Project Assignment at BPJS Ketenagakerjaan
jobs: Refactored a monolithic system into 3 microservices to improve scalability and maintainability.
Optimized slow database queries and tuned the database to keep a nationwide application, used by branch offices across Indonesia, fast and responsive.
Developed RESTful APIs and conducted unit testing, stress testing, and performance optimization.
Collaborated within Agile/Scrum teams using Jira for project management.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs: Built custom web applications end-to-end (frontend and backend) as one-off projects for multiple clients at a software house.
Integrated a wide range of third-party APIs, including payment gateways, WhatsApp, Google Maps, digital top-up, and identity verification services.
Developed APIs consumed by mobile applications built by other developers, collaborating closely with the mobile team.
Built the web application of a Point of Sale (POS) system, covering payment methods, sales reporting, and inventory management.
Applied microservices architecture and improved application performance through refactoring and automated testing.

projects.title: AI Training Partner - Taiwan Mobile
projects.description: AI Training Partner is an AI-powered interview and training platform built for Taiwan Mobile, letting candidates complete video-based interview and training sessions online. I focus on the user-facing application, building a resilient video upload pipeline with streaming upload, real-time progress tracking, automatic retry, and unified error handling.

projects.title: AI Training Partner - Admin Dashboard
projects.description: The admin and reviewer dashboard for the AI Training Partner platform, used by internal teams to manage interview questions, review candidate submissions, and control access. I implemented role-based access control and route protection with strict TypeScript typing.

projects.title: JWORKS - BPJS Ketenagakerjaan
projects.description: JWorks is a superapp for internal use at BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, functioning as a shortcut hub to access other internal applications within BPJS TK. In this project, I work as a Backend Developer, responsible for building APIs and integrating them with various internal BPJS TK applications.

projects.title: EPROC - BPJS Ketenagakerjaan
projects.description: EProc is an electronic procurement application developed for BPJS Ketenagakerjaan to streamline the procurement process.

projects.title: Mahameru Quick Response
projects.description: Mahameru Quick Response was developed using Vue JS and Express. Its purpose is to serve as an information hub for activities within the East Java Traffic Directorate (DITLANTAS Polda Jatim) as well as a monitoring tool for officers.

projects.title: My Greenhouse
projects.description: My Greenhouse is a monitoring application for temperature, humidity, and other conditions inside the greenhouse. It also provides control features for water pumps, fans, and more.

projects.title: Teguran Presisi
projects.description: Teguran Presisi was built with Vue JS and Laravel. It is an application designed for recording traffic violations and sending automated notifications through WhatsApp broadcasts.

projects.title: E-Latnis Setukpa
projects.description: E-Latnis is a training application developed for Setukpa Lemdiklat to support technical training programs.

projects.title: Melonku
projects.description: Melonku is designed using Vue JS and Express, focusing on selling fresh and high-quality melons directly from farmers to consumers.

projects.title: R3Store
projects.description: R3Store is a platform for purchasing digital items such as diamonds, UC, and vouchers for various popular games. It is built with a simple and responsive interface to ensure users can complete transactions quickly, safely, and conveniently.

projects.title: CCOD
projects.description: CCOD is a monitoring dashboard designed to observe and analyze data related to forests, mining areas, and more.
